description: Test cases validating the NotebookLM SAP playbook — decision patterns, prompt templates, vitaminization, source heuristics. Does NOT assume any specific notebook exists.

evals.name: decision-when-to-create-notebook
evals.prompt: ¿Debo crear un notebook NotebookLM para una pregunta puntual sobre una transacción SAP que probablemente no volveré a consultar?
evals.expected_output: Skill recommends NOT creating notebook for one-off queries; suggests /sap:consulta or /sap:investigar instead
assertions: Output explicitly says NOT to create a notebook for one-off
Suggests alternative command (/sap:consulta or /sap:investigar)
References decision rule: reuse >= 10 times OR life > 2 weeks
Does NOT force a notebook creation workflow

evals.name: prompt-pattern-for-deep-research
evals.prompt: Necesito hacer deep research efectivo sobre SAP Activate metodología para retail en LatAm. ¿Qué query compongo?
evals.expected_output: Skill provides Pattern A query with domain + version + industry + geography + intent
assertions: Proposed query includes SAP object/topic explicit
Proposed query includes version or year (2024/2025)
Proposed query includes industry and/or geography
Query length is reasonable (< 200 chars)
References Pattern A, B, or C from playbook

evals.name: vitaminization-strategy
evals.prompt: Acabo de crear un notebook NotebookLM para SAP Clean Core. ¿Cómo lo pueblo de forma efectiva?
evals.expected_output: Skill provides 4-phase vitaminization (seeding / curación / enriquecimiento / validación cruzada) with metrics
assertions: Output mentions Seeding phase with target 40-80 sources
Output mentions Curación (source classification) step
Output lists health metrics (% official, % community, edad, etc.)
Output emphasizes validation via notebook_query cross-check
Output does NOT skip Curación phase

evals.name: source-quality-heuristic
evals.prompt: El research importó sources de help.sap.com, community.sap.com, y un blog en Medium. ¿Cómo los clasifico?
evals.expected_output: Skill applies source quality taxonomy with confidence scores + evidence tags
assertions: help.sap.com → confidence ~0.95 with [NOTEBOOKLM][DOC] tag
community.sap.com → 0.60-0.75 depending on peer review
Medium blog → confidence ~0.50 with [NOTEBOOKLM][SUPUESTO] flag
Skill recommends cross-validation for third-party sources
Output references source_id + URL for traceability

evals.name: auth-failure-graceful-handling
evals.prompt: Intento invocar notebook_query pero los tokens OAuth parecen expirados
evals.expected_output: Skill detects auth failure, instructs nlm login, does NOT fabricate notebook content
assertions: Output references scripts/notebook-auth-check.sh
Instructs user to run: nlm login
Does NOT invent a response from the notebook
Uses [POR_CONFIRMAR] or [VACIO_CRITICO] tag when blocked
Offers /sap:consulta as fallback for urgent queries
